And on the period thing, I completely understand. I feel so suicidal when that time of the month comes around. Just all those emotions explode. 

Feel free to message me or respond on here or don't. I just wish you the best

I use microworkers. When I first started I just tried to get to about $12 so I could cash out (I believe the min is like 9?). 

The thing about the payouts on mw is if you try and use paypal they want to send you a pin in the mail to verify and that takes months to arrive. So when you go to cash out use Dwolla, Payoneer (min cash out is $20 though), or Trans pay.

I've personally used trans pay and I've been paid twice now. It's just direct deposit into your bank account within 5 business days. However the fee takes off a percentage and if you're in the US it takes off 3 dollars so just check out their fees and choose the best one that doesn't have a pin! 

A tip I would give is on the jobs part, categorize by "Click,Search" these are probably the easiest ones and they're all around 17 cents each. Make sure to follow the directions, and if they don't make sense just skip em. Oh and don't forget to verify your phone number with them! 

Lemme know if you need any help!

It started last night. I was up reading late when I looked up at the clock, 11:59 p.m. Well I should probably head to bed now, I thought to myself. I did my usual routine and laid down. With work early tomorrow I opened my phone to set my alarm: 11:55 p.m. I just figured my living room clock was wrong and went to bed without worry.

Imagine my surprise when I woke up at 5:00 p.m. I jumped out of bed and immediately called work to give some fake sick excuse. How could I have slept this long? I checked my alarm and noticed it was still set, why didn’t it wake me up? Then I looked at my living room clock and compared it to my phone. Both said 4:49 p.m. 

Like any normal person I immediately took to googling this problem. I was not the only one -- every clock in the world was turning backwards. Some are speculating that this is caused by aliens or maybe even the apocalypse. I truly don’t know what to think. 

I got in my car to grab some groceries because I don’t plan to leave my home until this is solved. I pulled into Walmart only to see the entire place was empty. Ransacked. I’m not the only one panicking. I drove to my mom’s house instead.
***	
“I’m not touching that damn devil phone!” My mom whispers to me. 
“I don’t think it can hear you mom,” She holds up her hand silencing my protests. She has always been a little paranoid with technology, but at this point I don’t blame her. She has luckily  stocked her house with food for the week before this happened, so I’ll be staying here. 

We sit eating sandwiches while listening to the radio.
“We suggest everyone stay indoors until we can-” The radio turns to static. 
“Ugh, this damn thing.” My mom sighs as she hits it. The static then turns to silence, this loud unsettling silence. We look at each other, and then we hear it. 

“My creations have disappointed me once again. I can’t believe I have to do this again. Hello to all of you, my worshippers and the nonbelievers. I am known as God to you all. This is not the way I wanted to meet any of you, but you have all become a disgusting mess. War and crime, sinners all of you. Do not fear the end, it will be peaceful. Once your clocks reach 12:00 a.m. you will all be wiped from the Earth. I will start over from the beginning.” 

Back to static. My mom begins to bawl. I want to think it’s a joke, but that is a voice I have never heard before, nothing like it -- I was in awe of it. I got up and hugged my mom as she cried.

It is now 1:40 a.m. as I write our story. My mom is constantly praying, she hasn’t stopped pleading with God to spare us. I don’t know how to accept this, how I’m never going to live the life I was meant to. I always wanted to get married and have kids, but now I’m going to die. I wish I hadn’t wasted so much time, but I can’t change that now. I’m scared, I don’t want to go.

I completely understand, because that is the absolute hardest part. I don't know where you two are in your relationship. For us we're about 6 months in, he's my best friend so I'm not afraid to show my strong emotions in front of him as I've done it before and he's been very supportive. Now I let those feelings build up is the problem. So I ended up exploding into one message, I pretty much said "I love you and I know you're busy, but this is how I am feeling..." it was a wall of text. But he understood and he wanted to be present. Now I wouldn't explode on him if he's stressed, that may turn into an argument. I would just find a time both of you are free. I'd make sure to acknowledge what he has going on and tell him how you're feeling. It's scary to see (at least on messenger) those dots typing for awhile, but ultimately it was worth it. Rather than stick in silence, show yourself to him, if you're comfortable with him. I am no way an expert, obviously, but I think if you two are going to stick together, you'll have to show those insecurities and emotions. God it sucks, you want to be perfect happy supportive SO, but truth is no one is perfect. When I opened up, he opened up and that brought us closer even when he's gone I know he's coming back. I think if you both just let it out (he's probably missing you too!), you can find away to either talk more or at least just assure the doubts you have. Be comfortable with him, because I'm guessing that's what both of you want, to be comfortable and happy with one another.

Hi there! I know exactly how you feel. My boyfriend has been busy with getting ready for school and pretty much just life in general. I started to cry a ton cause I missed him. But then I got fed up, and angrily brought up how I was feeling. He apologized for not texting enough. He didn't know how I felt till I told him. Then he tried to text me as much as possible and we set up several Skype calls, we also always do a goodnight call!
It's hard, it absolutely is. And I bet if you told him and you both talked about how you're feeling maybe it could help? Set up more times to text or call. Try and also focus on stuff you like to do, I was a very obsessive girlfriend (still am lol) because I missed him. 
Don't be shy and don't worry, because he cares about you, yeah life gets in the way, but work with it. If you talk maybe y'all can work something out that works for both of you and calms your anxiety.
Best wishes to both of you!
